name: Ben PI
source:
Ben PI is mystery visual novel about Margaret Bacon. She is private investigator who has to confront revolution by villains. Often, one chapter one case. Early chapters will introduce some of the villains.

[From [url=https://redtri17.itch.io/ben-pi]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Ben PI》是一部关于玛格丽特·培根的悬疑视觉小说。她是一名私家侦探，必须面对恶棍的革命。通常，一章一个案例。前面的章节将介绍一些恶棍。

[来自[url=https://redtri17.itch.io/ben-pi]itch.io[/url]]
